verified_findings: EventType.ROUND_REVIEW_STARTED exists but is absent from SIGNAL_EVENT_TYPES at the exact source commit.

The default JsonlEventSink behavior is signal verbosity; the test suite explicitly treats ordinary engineer.progress command-execution events as noise that is dropped from durable events.jsonl under signal/default mode while preserving signal events and win/error exceptions.
Mission View dispatch and _PROJECTED_EVENT_TYPES both include ROUND_REVIEW_STARTED and ENGINEER_PROGRESS at the exact source commit.
reduce_round_event maps ROUND_REVIEW_STARTED to durable reviewer-active state and role-work, while ENGINEER_PROGRESS updates active-role/timeline/role-work projection state.

Therefore the exact source supports a replay-invariant mismatch: a reviewer-active transition is projection-significant yet not guaranteed durable under default signal persistence, while ordinary engineer.progress is projection-significant despite being intentionally non-durable noise under the same default policy.

observations: The exact C32 schema-3 tuple resolves without aliasing to the exact open_source source artifact blob.

The worker artifact proposes adding round.review.started to the durable signal set and removing engineer.progress from durable Mission View dispatch/projected sets so Mission View remains reconstructible from canonical durable history.

Comparator-side inspection of the exact Argus commit confirms that round.review.started changes reviewer-active Mission View state but is not in SIGNAL_EVENT_TYPES, while engineer.progress is projected into Mission View even though ordinary progress is deliberately dropped by default signal persistence.

The existing event-verbosity tests establish the default/signal durability policy and the non-durability of ordinary engineer.progress, but they do not exercise round.review.started persistence or Mission View replay parity.

The source-level mismatch is technically concrete and the proposed patch locations are plausible, but no runtime replay, implementation, regression suite, or downstream compatibility test is attached to this exact tuple.
Candidate013 is a local durability/replay-consistency mechanism. It does not itself prove a complete zero-Work zero-quota zero-cost scheduled-Chat dependency-elimination route.
